facts.fact: Justice Minister Ziyambi Ziyambi announced in a Government Gazette notice the launch of the Digital Land Administration Platform (DLAP), described as a computerized land administration system for online processing of documents and deeds.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice, Legal and Parliamentary Affairs

facts.fact: Zimbabwe launched the Digital Land Administration Platform for electronic processing of title deeds, per a Government Gazette notice announced by Justice Minister Ziyambi Ziyambi.
Justice Minister Ziyambi Ziyambi said the DLAP enables farmers and landowners to apply for title deeds online, alongside the manual process.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice, Legal and Parliamentary Affairs

ZWE.note: No account ownership survey figure stated.
No retail digital payment service stated.

facts.fact: Justice Minister Ziyambi Ziyambi said applicants on the DLAP can pay deed fees electronically under the Gazette's Fourth Schedule or by the manual process in the Second Schedule.
